name: LEHMAN BROTHERS UK CAPITAL FUNDING III LP

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Notice of Interim Payment
announcements.insight: Lehman Brothers UK Capital Funding III LP has issued a notice of interim payment following its August proposal. This confirms the execution of the previously suggested distribution mechanism.

announcements.headline: Notice of Interim Payment
announcements.insight: Lehman Brothers UK Capital Funding III LP proceeds with an interim payment following the August proposal. Shareholders should monitor for subsequent court sanction or distribution details.

announcements.headline: Notice of Proposed Interim Payment
announcements.insight: Lehman Brothers UK Capital Funding III LP proposes an interim payment. Shareholders should monitor for subsequent court meetings or sanction orders to understand the process outcome.
